resources.string: Explore the replay. Use AR to place the pool on a table.
Ball hidden. Tap its remembered location or enter a guess.
R: Red team B: Blue team Yellow: Ball

Explore simulated water-polo and swimming positions. Drag the timeline, change playback speed, or pause to inspect a frame.

Find ball pauses water polo and hides the ball. Tap its remembered position or enter pool coordinates. A guess within 2 m counts as found.

AR: allow the camera, scan a textured table in good light, then tap a detected surface. Walk around the pool or choose Place again. Preview works without camera permission or ARCore.

Data is synthetic, not a live match or automatic swimmer tracking. Camera frames are not uploaded by this app. AR uses Google Play Services for AR; its privacy information is available below.
Camera access was declined. The preview remains available.
Enable camera in Settings to use AR. Preview needs no permission.
AR is unavailable here. You can use all replay controls in preview.
AR could not start. Return to preview and retry after checking Google Play Services for AR.
Replay data could not be loaded. Reinstall the app to restore the bundled fixtures.
Pool replay. Red players are labelled R, blue players B, and swimmers by lane. Use Enter guess for an accessible ball challenge.
